query: 环境策略与政策声明 环境策略与政策声明 衡量企业环境战略、政策承诺及治理机制完整性。 一、内容质量得分 (权重 50%，取值：0, 1, 2) • 2分（卓越）：具备系统的环境政策，涵盖全价值链边界；设定了科学的短期与中长期环境目标；明确了董事会及高管层的专项职责，且披露了明确的政策审议与修订频率。 • 1分（合格）：发布了正式的环境政策声明，包含基础的管理目标和职责分配，但在政策边界描述、目标的科学性或董事会实质性参与方面披露不足。 • 0分（不合格）：无正式环境政策披露，或仅有碎片化的环保措施描述。 二、覆盖应用得分 (权重 50%，取值：0, 1, 2) • 2分（高覆盖）：环境政策覆盖 >80% 的业务单元、子公司、生产基地及核心经营地区。 • 1分（部分覆盖）：占比 >0% - 80%，或仅适用于集团总部/部分区域，或未说明政策在全集团的推行范围。 • 0分（无覆盖）：无相关覆盖范围信息。 环境政策 环境策略 环境管理体系 政策边界 董事会环境监督 政策审议频率 集团环境政策 ISO 14001 EMS environmental policy environmental strategy environmental management system policy boundary board oversight of environment policy review frequency group-wide environmental policy ISO 14001 EMS 企业是否发布正式环境政策或策略声明？ 政策边界是否覆盖全价值链或主要业务？ 是否设定短期与中长期环境目标？ 董事会或高管的环境职责如何规定？ 政策审议与修订频率是什么？ 政策覆盖哪些业务单元或地区？
instruction: Assess whether the passage provides concrete evidence for the ESG indicator '环境策略与政策声明'. Prefer explicit, auditable disclosure that answers: 企业是否发布正式环境政策或策略声明？ 政策边界是否覆盖全价值链或主要业务？ 是否设定短期与中长期环境目标？ 董事会或高管的环境职责如何规定？ 政策审议与修订频率是什么？ 政策覆盖哪些业务单元或地区？ Exclude or down-rank: 排除：仅有零散环保项目；仅有排放数据表；仅有合规许可证列表；仅有“绿色发展”口号；仅有ISO 14001证书或EMS名称而无正式环境政策、管理目标和职责分配。区分：本指标关注企业环境政策、目标、职责、审议机制及覆盖；供应商环境标准关注供应链准入；ESG监督委员会是治理架构。 Preserve relevant tables, notes, units, limitations, policies, targets, methods and coverage details.

[Content]
As the Group's core business is in chemical manufacturing, we are committed to managing and minimizing the environmental impacts of our operations. Most of the plants of the Group have obtained ISO 14001 environmental management system certification, and some have also obtained ISO 50001 energy management system certification. To effectively manage the environmental performance of the Group's plants, the HSE Committee under the Board is responsible for formulating environmental strategies and monitoring related risks and effectiveness, and the HSE Department is responsible for day-to-day monitoring.

results.section: 持份者參與 STAKEHOLDER ENGAGEMENT
results.text: The materiality assessment from 2019 was designed in accordance with the Global Reporting Initiative (GRI) Standards . The seven topics rated as 'critical' include: waste management, environmental compliance, air emission management, green products R&D, occupational health and safety, product safety, and product quality management. The Board will continue to review and strengthen the management of these sustainability issues and will regularly review potential changes in their materiality to the Group's business. Please refer to the 'Long-term Values in the Environment', 'Long-term Values in Employees' and 'Long-term Values in Customers' sections of this report for information on the management approach and effectiveness of measures on these material issues.

results.section: 環境的長遠價值 LONG-TERM VALUES IN THE ENVIRONMENT
results.text: During the year under review, some of the emissions, energy consumption and usage of some packaging materials increased in the plants as disclosed under the 'Environmental Performance' section in this report. This was mainly due to the increase in production volumes at the Taixing solvents plant and the Jinshan coatings plant as compared to year 2020, as well as the increased use of vehicles by the sales teams for business occasions as the Group's businesses strove for sales growth. Despite this, the Group continues to take various measures to monitor and manage our production processes to further reduce our environmental impact.

[Content]
During the year under review, some of the emissions, energy consumption and usage of some packaging materials increased in the plants as disclosed under the 'Environmental Performance' section in this report. This was mainly due to the increase in production volumes at the Taixing solvents plant and the Jinshan coatings plant as compared to year 2020, as well as the increased use of vehicles by the sales teams for business occasions as the Group's businesses strove for sales growth. Despite this, the Group continues to take various measures to monitor and manage our production processes to further reduce our environmental impact.

results.text: The Group has a Policy on Management of Product Quality and Safety Risks which assesses product quality on two main aspects, including quality and performance, as well as safety and environmental considerations. In addition to meeting customer requirements, we also ensure that our products meet the requirements of regional, national, and international laws, regulations, and standards.

results.text: Most of the Group's subsidiaries have implemented ISO 9001 Certified Quality Management System and monitored the entire process from product R&D, production, and quality inspection to product delivery through an Enterprise Resource Planning ('ERP') system. results.section: 顧客的長遠價值 LONG-TERM VALUES IN CUSTOMERS
results.text: As one of the first companies in the China inks industry to introduce a hazardous substance management system, Bauhinia Ink, the Group's subsidiary, has established a hazardous substance database and a regulations database to control over 40 substances such as heavy metals and organic compounds in its products, and to ensure compliance with relevant product standards and environmental standards in countries and regions including the European Union, the United States, and Japan. We continuously improve our ability to assess product safety, and manage and control risks in inks plants by adopting fully pipelined manufacturing in benzene-free production conditions, while control systems are automatic and linked to an ERP system for comprehensive production process monitoring.
results.retrieval_text:
[Section]
顧客的長遠價值 LONG-TERM VALUES IN CUSTOMERS

[Content]
As one of the first companies in the China inks industry to introduce a hazardous substance management system, Bauhinia Ink, the Group's subsidiary, has established a hazardous substance database and a regulations database to control over 40 substances such as heavy metals and organic compounds in its products, and to ensure compliance with relevant product standards and environmental standards in countries and regions including the European Union, the United States, and Japan. We continuously improve our ability to assess product safety, and manage and control risks in inks plants by adopting fully pipelined manufacturing in benzene-free production conditions, while control systems are automatic and linked to an ERP system for comprehensive production process monitoring.
